definitions.explanation: The number of years since a building was constructed, an important factor in real estate.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{築年数|ちくねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧20⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧だ。
examples.english: This apartment building is 20 years old.

examples.japanese: {築年数|ちくねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property that's relatively new.

examples.japanese: {築年数|ちくねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}っている→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧、⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The rent is cheap because the building is older.

notes:
REAL ESTATE TERM:
A key factor in property valuations. Generally, older buildings have lower rent/prices but may have different characteristics.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {築年数|ちくねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧ - relatively new (lit. "shallow years")
- {築年数|ちくねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}っている→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ - older building
- ⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧◯⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ - ◯ years old (e.g., ⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧10⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ = 10 years old)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧◯⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ - ◯ years old (shorter form in listings)
- ⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧ - newly constructed
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧ - second-hand, pre-owned
